asset.label: Rootward
asset.catalog_notes: Monumental 24-metre namesake oak, roughly 24 metres across. Twisted bole, huge branching buttress roots, living amber fissures, gold ward-stone ring, thirty suspended jewel lanterns, nine festoon garlands and editable wisp/light anchors. The saved Blender master owns all geometry and anchors; small rendering-only lights/motes animate in Godot. Gameplay uses a permanent trunk cutaway: authored Crown/Boughs parts stay hidden, upper trunk/chains fade from 8 to 10 metres, and only lower lanterns get halos/local lights. The complete adopted source and GLB remain intact.

catalog_entry.label: Rootward
catalog_entry.pivot: Ground center; Blender Z-up; one metre per cell
catalog_entry.behavior: Static namesake landmark; the trunk, buttress roots and ward-stone ring block movement. Canopy overhang is decorative.
